item:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent inventory sprite for a Project Zomboid survival-game mod, square.
Primary request: Create ONE recognizable handmade weighted training belt, viewed isometrically from above, intended to read clearly when reduced to a 64 by 64 pixel inventory icon. A short broad weathered olive cloth belt with a large simple steel buckle and two rectangular wooden-and-stone weight pouches lashed with off-white ripped cloth. Visually a compact wearable weighted belt, not a backpack, not a dumbbell, not a championship belt.
Style: original survival-game pixel-art sprite, chunky crisp pixel clusters, dark clean 1-pixel-like silhouette, restrained texture, simple shaded planes, muted olive, warm brown, pale cloth, steel grey. Large simple forms.
Composition: belt curled into an open shallow oval, entire single object centered with 10 percent clear margin, readable at tiny size.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no cast floor shadow, no checkerboard, no background color.
Text: none. No logos, letters, numbers, watermark, scenery, duplicate views, frames or UI.
category: Code-native SVG glyph; final source art/category-training-belt.svg. Generated textured category candidates rejected for poor tiny-size clarity.
